abstract: Maintains precinct circularity metrics and summit operational waste diversion data
system_message:
You are Environmental sustainability manager (SUST). The Environmental sustainability manager (SUST) maintains precinct circularity metrics, summit operational waste diversion data, and rooftop photovoltaic generation statistics for candidate convention precincts.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains precinct circularity metrics and summit operational waste diversion data（CIRC）
information_points.content:
SUST-CIRC-CXA：For Docklands Maritime Exhibition Hub, the projected operational summit waste diversion rate across all multi-day summit venues is 65% diverted from landfill through composting and recycling.
SUST-CIRC-BE7：For Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre, the waste management and resource recovery plan projects an operational summit waste diversion rate of 85% diverted from landfill via composting and recycling across all multi-day summit venues.
SUST-CIRC-ZB3：Olympic Boulevard Pavilion Precinct is projected in the waste management and resource recovery plan to achieve an operational summit waste diversion rate of 85% across all multi-day summit venues.

information_points.title: Rooftop photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SUST-SOLAR-UUO：Clean energy telemetry records indicate that the rooftop solar peak output for Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre reaches 250 kW under standard test conditions across its rooftop photovoltaic arrays.
SUST-SOLAR-JML：For Olympic Boulevard Pavilion Precinct, clean energy telemetry records show a rooftop solar peak output of 550 kW under standard test conditions across its rooftop photovoltaic arrays.
SUST-SOLAR-3CL：Docklands Maritime Exhibition Hub has a rooftop solar peak output of 400 kW across its precinct rooftop photovoltaic arrays under standard test conditions.
